name: Transwestern Gas Pipeline / San Juan 2005 Expansion
researcher_notes: Source: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook, August 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 362: TW San Juan 2005 Expansion, operator Transwestern Pipeline Co, type Expansion, status Completed May 2005, state NM, cost 138.4 million, 72.6 miles, 375 MMcf/d added, 36 inch, interstate, FERC docket CP04-104. Not an existing row: P0273 is the 4,345 mile main line and P7840 is the proposed Desert Southwest Expansion; neither is this loop. Adds 72.6 mi, above the 15.5 mi rule. Capacity is incremental. Single origin (EIA); a FERC order for CP04-104 was not pulled, so the second source is still owed if cheap. ProposalYear left blank (not sourced). Start and end given as state only (New Mexico, San Juan Lateral); exact endpoints not found. Route: no route, not researched. Owner style per entity_style: Transwestern Pipeline Co; GEM parent system lists ETP Legacy.
